headline: Investors push back on Anthropic's $1.5 trillion IPO valuation, The Decoder reports
body: The Decoder, says, according to Reuters, potential backers doubt the planned roadshow can kick off next week as scheduled. Investors want a steeper discount because Anthropic is still losing money, The Decoder says, and one investor reportedly floated a valuation of just $1 trillion. The Decoder adds that as recently as September the company was eyeing up to $2 trillion.
note: A delayed or repriced offering would be a signal for how public investors value the labs that banks and payment firms depend on. The Decoder says a delay could further shake confidence in the broader AI sector.

evidence.text: Anthropic's IPO is in trouble as investors push back on the $1.5 trillion valuation and the tech market sells off.
According to Reuters , potential backers doubt the planned roadshow can kick off next week as scheduled.
As recently as September, the company was eyeing a valuation of up to $2 trillion .
One investor reportedly floated a valuation of just $1 trillion.
Investors want a steeper discount because Anthropic is still losing money and burning through cash to scale its AI infrastructure.
A delay could further shake confidence in the broader AI sector.
